paragraphs.en: AI Agent Builder and Runtime by Docker Engineering
paragraphs.zh: Docker 工程团队打造的 AI 智能体构建器与运行时

paragraphs.en: Build, run, and share AI agents with a declarative YAML config, rich tool ecosystem, and multi-agent orchestration.
paragraphs.zh: 使用声明式 YAML 配置、丰富的工具生态和多智能体编排，构建、运行和共享 AI 智能体。

paragraphs.en: docker-agent lets you create and run intelligent AI agents that collaborate to solve complex problems — no code required.
paragraphs.zh: docker-agent 让你能够创建和运行协作解决复杂问题的智能 AI 智能体——无需编写代码。

paragraphs.en: docker-agent is a docker CLI plugin and can be run with docker agent .
paragraphs.zh: docker-agent 是一个 docker CLI 插件，可以通过 docker agent 命令运行。

paragraphs.en: Define agents in YAML, give them tools, and let them work.
paragraphs.zh: 用 YAML 定义智能体，为它们配备工具，让它们开始工作。

paragraphs.en: agents : root : model : openai/gpt-5-mini description : A helpful AI assistant instruction : | You are a knowledgeable assistant that helps users with various tasks. Be helpful, accurate, and concise in your responses. toolsets : - type : mcp ref : docker:duckduckgo docker agent run agent.yaml Key Features Multi-agent architecture — Create teams of specialized agents that delegate tasks automatically Rich tool ecosystem — Built-in tools + any MCP server (local, remote, or Docker-based) AI provider agnostic — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, Mistral, xAI, Docker Model Runner , and more YAML configuration — Declarative, versionable, shareable Advanced reasoning — Built-in think, todo, and memory tools RAG — Pluggable retrieval with BM25, embeddings, hybrid search, and reranking Package & share — Push agents to any OCI registry, pull and run them anywhere Install Docker Desktop (4.63+) — docker-agent CLI plugin is pre-installed. Just run docker agent .
paragraphs.zh: agents : root : model : openai/gpt-5-mini description : 一个乐于助人的 AI 助手 instruction : | 你是一个知识渊博的助手，帮助用户完成各种任务。 在回答中保持有帮助、准确且简洁。 toolsets : - type : mcp ref : docker:duckduckgo docker agent run agent.yaml 主要特性 多智能体架构——创建由专门化智能体组成的团队，自动委派任务 丰富的工具生态——内置工具 + 任意 MCP 服务器（本地、远程或基于 Docker） AI 提供商无关——OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、AWS Bedrock、Mistral、xAI、Docker Model Runner 等 YAML 配置——声明式、可版本化、可共享 高级推理——内置 think、todo 和 memory 工具 RAG——可插拔检索，支持 BM25、嵌入、混合搜索和重排序 打包与分享——将智能体推送到任意 OCI 镜像仓库，在任何地方拉取并运行 安装 Docker Desktop（4.63+）——docker-agent CLI 插件已预装。只需运行 docker agent 。

paragraphs.en: Homebrew — brew install docker-agent . Run docker-agent directly or symlink the binary to ~/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-agent and run docker agent .
paragraphs.zh: Homebrew — 运行 brew install docker-agent 。 直接运行 docker-agent，或将该二进制文件符号链接到 ~/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-agent，然后运行 docker agent 。

sents.zh: Homebrew — 运行 brew install docker-agent 。

sents.en: Run docker-agent directly or symlink the binary to ~/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-agent and run docker agent .
sents.zh: 直接运行 docker-agent，或将该二进制文件符号链接到 ~/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-agent，然后运行 docker agent 。

paragraphs.en: Binary releases — Download from GitHub Releases . Symlink the docker-agent binary to ~/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-agent to be able to use docker agent , or use docker-agent directly.
paragraphs.zh: 二进制发行版 — 从 GitHub Releases 下载。 将 docker-agent 二进制文件符号链接到 ~/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-agent，以便使用 docker agent，或者直接使用 docker-agent。

paragraphs.en: Set at least one API key (or use Docker Model Runner for local models):
paragraphs.zh: 至少设置一个 API 密钥（或使用 Docker Model Runner 运行本地模型）：

paragraphs.en: export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... # or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, etc. See Set Up a Model for the full walkthrough of both paths (cloud API key or local model).

paragraphs.en: # Run the default agent docker agent run # Run from an OCI registry docker agent run myorg/agent:tag # Generate a new agent interactively docker agent new # Run your own config docker agent run agent.yaml More examples in the examples/ directory.
paragraphs.zh: # 运行默认智能体 docker agent run # 从 OCI registry 运行 docker agent run myorg/agent:tag # 交互式生成一个新的智能体 docker agent new # 运行你自己的配置 docker agent run agent.yaml 更多示例请参见 examples/ 目录。
